commits.message:
docs: name the two upward edges out of core, and widen the check that finds them

The dependency section claimed no back-edges and shipped a grep that could
not have found one. `from "\./[a-z]+\.js"` matches same-directory imports
only, so a reader verifying the claim the way the section told them to would
get a clean result while an upward import sat three lines away — a hand-
written claim standing next to a check that cannot falsify it, which is the
failure this epic exists to remove.

There are two such edges, and they are now named rather than implied absent:
color.ts imports Palette from themes/ (safe: themes/palette.ts only
import-types back, so no runtime cycle) and console.ts imports Rule from
renderables/. Both are deliberate and annotated at their call sites. An
undocumented exception is what becomes an accidental cycle; a named one is a
seam. The pattern now matches `../` too.

Also drops the last "flagship" framing from themes-and-color-studio: the
printed banner still called it "the flagship Themes & Color demo" while the
header rewritten in eef1954 says it is not the template for future demos.
The file contradicted itself in the output users actually see.

docs: rewrite the CLAUDE.md architecture and commands sections (rich-docs-vk9.5)

Every factual claim in these sections is now checked against the tree.

Commands: lint is three passes over four tsconfigs, not `tsc --noEmit`, and
test/ is among them — a broken type in a test fails lint while vitest is
green. Adds the docs, demo, and playwright scripts.

Architecture:

- Drop the spec-driven-development section; docs/ is the single description.
  Keeps the concrete failure as a negative example: the briefs documented a
  named-colour function family (red, on, hex) that src/template-bindings/
  had replaced with fg/bg, so a template written from them fails with
  FuncNotFound.
- Replace "two-layer structure" with the six real subsystems, including
  widgets, themes, template-bindings, and the node/ capability seam.
- Add oklch, render, sanitize, and strip to the primitives list.
- Rebuild the dependency diagram from the actual imports. The old one was
  wrong in its arrows — it drew `cells → color` when both import nothing —
  so it is now build-order tiers, extracted per module and reproducible with
  the grep the section names.
- Fix color: there is no Color class and no Color.parse. The exports are
  ColorRgba, ColorSpec (ColorSpec.parse is cached), ColorTable, ColorDepth.
- Document the browser-safe barrel rule next to the dependency order, since
  it constrains every change that adds an import, and test/coverage/ as the
  gate on every change that adds an export.

docs: delete the spec directory (rich-docs-vk9.4)

Remove spec/ — 25 files, 2035 lines of doc-authoring briefs that described
the same surface as docs/ and had drifted into contradicting src/. The last
three unconsumed briefs landed in docs/ across #63, #64, and #65; nothing of
value lived only here.

Repoint the four source references the briefs left behind:

- src/template-bindings/style-funcs.ts → docs/style.md
- src/widgets/dropdown.ts → docs/widgets.md
- test/template-bindings/style-funcs.test.ts → describes the fragment
  contract inline; spec/template-bindings.md's "Cell-splitting algorithm
  (consumer side)" section has no counterpart in docs/
- examples/themes-and-color-studio/app.ts → the "consolidated ownership map
  is spec/demos.md" paragraph is deleted rather than repointed. That model
  (five flagships with source-module ownership) was repealed, not moved:
  rich-demos-l2x now lists it under "Non-goals (explicit rejections, learned
  the hard way)" and closed children .4-.7 as obsolete.

Supersedes PR #35, which deleted spec/demos.md and this same framing. That
branch is 15 months old and CONFLICTING; its app.ts hunks patch text that
has since moved out of index.ts. Its coverage-allowlist typing work (the
Flagship union, burndown(), the discriminated AllowlistEntry) is still worth
having and is refiled against current master.

docs: fold the demos brief into the README demo section (rich-docs-vk9.3) (#65)

`spec/demos.md` was the last unconsumed authoring brief. Most of it is not
stale but repealed: the parent epic `rich-demos-l2x` now lists the
five-flagship model with source-module ownership under "Non-goals (explicit
rejections, learned the hard way)" and closed children .4-.7 as obsolete.
Publishing the ownership rule, the per-flagship export lists, or the
deletions table would re-issue a retired design, so they are discarded
rather than moved.

What survives is the coverage contract, which is true, load-bearing, and
documented in no prose anywhere: the verifier derives its universe from
`package.json#exports` at test-load time, counts coverage per symbol origin,
ignores namespace imports, and validates the allowlist for both dead and
redundant entries. That folds into the README as "Demo coverage is checked,
not claimed", along with the two facts a demo author needs first —
`examples/shared/` counts because the verifier walks every file, and a demo
reaches the browser gallery only via `examples/<name>/wire.ts`.

Folding it in also settles a contradiction. The README's hand-maintained
"Not yet exercised" table was a second source for what the verifier already
computes, and every one of the 16 symbols checked (`Status`, `Prompt`,
`Measurement`, `emojiReplace`, `StyleStack`, the `Box` variants, ...) is
absent from `coverage-allowlist.ts`, meaning a demo already covers it. Both
hand-maintained coverage lists are deleted; the check that cannot drift
replaces them.

Also corrected in the same section:
- `PaletteResolver` no longer exists. Section 5 of themes-and-color-studio
  is now "Colour references" over `resolveColorRef` / `parseHexColor` /
  `ColorRefError`; the intro line and the features-table row say so.
- "Two are explained in detail below" listed three headings. The demo list
  is regrouped by interactive vs transcript, and the three detailed demos
  are named.
- The bugs-found table cited line numbers that had drifted; it now cites
  path plus symbol, each verified present.
- Added the live demo gallery link (verified 200) and a pointer back from
  the gallery page.

Verification: `npm run docs:build` clean (it is also the dead-link and Vue
interpolation check), `npm run lint` clean, `coverage.test.ts` green with
all four invariants matching the prose that now describes them.
